title: Certificate-prefix symmetric family: coefficient/exponent pair (3, 1) via a self-contained flat-potential elimination and a from-scratch disperser proof

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The certificate-prefix symmetric family, defined for every integer N>=0 by one fixed evaluator in proof.md Section 1 and family.py: N=0 gives 0; B is the smallest integer with B^5>64N^3 and k the smallest prime >=B; if k>=N, or with m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)) the guards t>=r or kt<r(r+1) fail, the output is 0; otherwise the first k input bits encode a monic polynomial Q over F_2, tested exactly for irreducibility of prime degree k (Z^(2^k)=Z mod Q and gcd(Q,Z^2+Z)=1; failure outputs 0), and with K=F_2[Z]/(Q) and the remaining m payload bits zero-padded to r blocks a_1..a_r of K, the output is the constant coordinate of sigma_t(y_1..y_r), y_i=a_i^(2^(w_i)-1), w_i=r+2-i. The language L={x: A(x)=1} is in P (hence NP, empty witnesses, W(N)=0) for this one fixed evaluator A.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"3"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"3"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N) >= 3N - R(N) with R(N)=3k+6(floor(kr/t)+kt+r(r+1)+1)=O(N^(4/5)) for every integer N passing the guards (and the bound extends to all sufficiently large integer N), in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length N=|x|; hence liminf C_B2(F_N)/N >= 3.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
